source: SLAM_PROD_DB_10.05.2022 lookup tables (WheelReadingPurpose, WheelProfile, ScheduleTypes). Decode values captured live from the server and cross-checked against the SLAM website rows for 39023/33762/51061/30397/41201/33674.

calibration.method: fleet-level empirical prior P(recorded wear reason present | ratio-argmax dimension), estimated on fresh Bronze (2026-08-20), n=41,276 turns; applied ONLY when recorded_reason is absent (provenance never overwritten)
calibration.note: Per-shed priors exist in models/phase5/report/attribution_calibration.json for sheds with >=20 turns, but shed coverage is limited to ~30% of turns by wheelset migration; fleet priors are the default. See ml/docs/slam_website_field_mapping.md.
